notes.title: Ver. 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
The version 1.4 update for Saiku's Endless Labyrinth brings a whole new way to play the game as well as much needed changes to existing features. For support transferring existing save data to the new version, see the guide on the Community page: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2096419655

New to 1.4: Monster Repellent

A new Monster Repellent item allows players to reduce the number of monsters they encounter. This makes focusing on getting through the mazes much easier, as monsters are less of a problem in your path.

Fear not though, as Monster Repellent also doubles item drops, meaning you will be at no disadvantage. In addition, the Monster Repellent is an equippable item, so you can choose how you want to play.


Minor Change: Save Points Have Moved!

Save points for zone bosses have now been moved to the end of the last maze, rather than being in the boss rooms themselves. This should help with any issues relating to being under-leveled for a boss battle.

notes.title: Patch Ver. 1.3
notes.notes:
Hi all!

I've been reading community posts and decided to run through the game again to check if anything else was causing a problem. I think I've got pretty much everything that I've seen mentioned and a couple of extra little bugs too.

Thanks to everyone who has posted on the community page about bugs and stuff and sorry for any inconvenience caused!

I would also like to mention a new guide available in the community for transferring save data.
